Immediately, Lina presses the lever down once with the same right hand; the lever moves under pressure, but the Workshop door remains closed. She then releases the lever naturally and the lever returns to its resting position. The hand remains near the lever without changing hands or leaving the contact area. The camera does not move and there is no cut; the Workshop interior, centered far-wall window, daylight, and table to the right of the window remain fixed spatial anchors. Subtle hand and sleeve movement accompanies a quiet lever click and release.
